relevance_note: Case report of a male with Danon disease and a LAMP2 splice variant: 'Whole-exome sequencing identified a hemizygous splice-donor variant in LAMP2 (NM_002294.2:c.928 + 1G > A)'.
method_note: Read by hand; no tables in the paper; JSON assembled with a short Python script from my own reading, spans checked verbatim by script. Labels: the proband is labelled III-1 in the Figure 2G legend (the text otherwise uses role words), his mother II-1. The proband's father is mentioned only as giving consent and is out of scope. Mother II-1 is a 'presumed carrier' never genetically tested; her history is reported by the proband; no variant row for her; disease label left 'not reported' (the paper gives no diagnosis, only presumed carrier status, recorded in clinical_diagnosis_basis). Inheritance for III-1 left 'not reported' because the mother was not tested. 'ref (6) patient': the Methods-like paragraph says the same variant 'was identified in a patient with dilated cardiomyopathy'; the sentence ends with citation (6), but (5) is cited in the preceding sentence and (6) may refer only to the c.928 + 1G > T variant, so the source reference is uncertain. Included under the v4 rule (variant and a feature given). Its variant string is quoted from the proband's sentence because the sentence says 'it'. The c.928 + 1G > T carrier is not described as a person and gets no row. Contradictions: (1) the patient is '29-year-old' at presentation and 'succumbed to the disease 18 months after diagnosis', yet the Discussion says 'fatal outcome at the age of 29'; deceased age recorded as P29Y from that sentence, age at diagnosis not stated and left not reported. (2) Protein: abstract says 'decreased LAMP2 protein expression' and Conclusion 'reduction of LAMP2 protein expression', while Results say 'No detectable LAMP2 protein was observed'; Results quoted. (3) Figure 2C legend says LAMP2 TPM 'falls within the lower range of controls'. Retinal: 'macular degeneration', 'macular pathology with pigmentary changes' and 'the patient's retinopathy' were taken as observed for the pigmentary retinopathy/retinal dystrophy checklist item. 'Severe biventricular enlargement' was not taken as right ventricular hypertrophy. 'Frequent supraventricular premature beats' were not taken as supraventricular tachycardia. 'Patent coronary arteries' recorded as excluded coronary artery obstruction (D-27). DCM in ref (6) patient taken as observed for the dilated LV checklist item. Feature onset '5-year history' is a duration before presentation, not an age, so onset_iso8601 is null.
